text: The human voice carries identity, emotion, and the rhythm of lived experience.
interpretation: Cosine similarity is computed after L2 normalization at each stage.
Style cosine compares 256-D StyleTTS2 conditioning vectors.
ECAPA cosine compares synthesized audio embeddings; >0.90 is near-duplicate voice territory for this model, not proof of perceptual identity.
No human identity or naturalness judgment was collected.
